hero.subtitle: Prenatal Spa Ritual for Expecting Mothers in Turrialba
hero.p1: A moment to disconnect, breathe, and enjoy this beautiful and special chapter of your life.
hero.p2: During pregnancy, your body changes, your routine changes, and your priorities change. And while everyone is asking how the baby is doing, there is someone who needs care too:
hero.p3: The Prenatal Spa Ritual at MJ Estética & Spa was created to give you a moment to pause, rest, and enjoy a wellness experience specially designed for expecting mothers.
hero.p4: A space where you don't have to do anything—just relax, breathe, and let yourself be pampered.
hero.cta: I WANT TO BOOK MY PRENATAL RITUAL

moreThanMassage.title: More Than a Massage: A Moment Just for You
moreThanMassage.p1: Pregnancy can come with tiredness, muscle tension, a feeling of heaviness, and countless responsibilities. That's why we created a different kind of experience.
moreThanMassage.p2: The Prenatal Spa Ritual combines relaxation, care, and personalized attention to help you enjoy a peaceful moment during your pregnancy.
moreThanMassage.priorityDesc: We adapt the experience to your stage of pregnancy and your individual needs, creating a comfortable and enjoyable experience from beginning to end.

whyDeserve.title: Why Do You Deserve This Moment?
whyDeserve.p1: Because you've been taking care of everything: taking care of your nutrition, keeping up with your appointments, preparing for your baby's arrival, thinking about every little detail.
whyDeserve.asked: And you've probably heard this question countless times: “How's the baby?”
whyDeserve.question: But today, we want to ask you: How are YOU? ❤️
whyDeserve.invitation: The Prenatal Spa Ritual is an invitation to pause, to breathe, to relax, to feel cared for, and to enjoy your pregnancy.
whyDeserve.tagline: 🌷 Because taking care of yourself matters too.
whyDeserve.cta: I WANT TO GIVE MYSELF THIS MOMENT

includes.title: What Does Your Prenatal Spa Ritual Include?
includes.desc: We've designed the experience so that from the moment you arrive, you can leave your daily routine behind for a while.

items.d: Before we begin, we'll talk with you about your stage of pregnancy, your needs, and your preferences.
The experience is adapted to help you remain comfortable and relaxed throughout your treatment.
We use gentle techniques focused on relaxation and overall well-being, adapted to the needs of the expecting mother.
A private and peaceful space where you can disconnect from the responsibilities of the day.
Every detail is thoughtfully designed to turn a massage session into a true wellness ritual.
Because not everything has to revolve around preparing for the baby's arrival. This moment is for you.

expectation.title: What Can You Expect From the Experience?
expectation.p1: When you arrive at MJ Estética & Spa, we want you to feel as though you've just entered a space where you can slow down. Put your phone away. Take a deep breath. Close your eyes. And allow yourself to rest.
expectation.p2: The goal isn't simply to provide a massage.
expectation.highlight: We want you to leave feeling cared for, relaxed, and special.

items.d: Every pregnancy is different. That's why we listen to your needs and adapt the experience to your comfort.

items.t: A Space Designed for Your Well-Being
items.d: We've created an environment where you can disconnect from your routine and dedicate some time exclusively to yourself.
We don't want you to simply come in for a massage. We want you to experience a wellness ritual.
Visit us in Turrialba, Cartago, Costa Rica, and enjoy a wellness experience without having to travel outside the area.

experienceNotRace.title: An Experience to Enjoy, Not a Race
experienceNotRace.p1: Pregnancy is a unique journey that deserves to be lived with calm, presence, and joy.
experienceNotRace.quote: Give yourself the permission to pause.
experienceNotRace.tagline: We are ready to welcome you and give you the experience you deserve.

items.q: When is the best time to have a spa treatment before a wedding or during pregnancy?
items.a: A relaxing spa experience can be scheduled from the second trimester onwards, or anywhere from 1 to 7 days before an event, depending on your preferences.
Yes. Our prenatal massages use gentle, pregnancy-safe techniques and adapted positioning to ensure complete safety and comfort.

items.q: Can I request a personalized gift voucher?
items.a: Yes! We offer customized digital or physical gift vouchers for expecting mothers.

items.q: Can a massage help with stress during pregnancy?
items.a: Relaxing massages can help promote relaxation, ease muscle tension, and reduce pregnancy fatigue.
